blocks.text: THE HAGUE —The International Criminal Court (ICC) on Wednesday found an ex-Central African Republic rebel commander guilty on four counts of crimes against humanity, including torture and unlawful imprisonment. The ICC convicted Mahamat Said Abdel Kani, 56, who oversaw beatings and maltreatment as head of a feared prison unit as the CAR spiraled into civil war […]... Keep on reading: ICC convicts C.
